name: Big East Cross Country Championships
headline: Big East Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Providence won the women's title with 36 points, ahead of Villanova (44) and Connecticut (59), as Georgetown's Barrett Justema won the 6K in 19:31.5. Georgetown took the men's title with 33 points to Villanova's 40, with Villanova's Bailey Habler winning the 8K in 22:58.3.
